entry.title: SOC AI has reached the logs. Mostly, it writes the query.

link.title: SOC AI has reached the logs. Mostly, it writes the query.

entry.summary: SOC AI used to mean alert triage: summarise the alert, suggest a verdict. Now the pitch is that agents work directly on logs and telemetry. Some of that is real. But at carrier scale, “works on logs” still mostly means “writes a query that a person or a platform runs on data already indexed.” That difference matters to me.
